proposed_updates.why_no_new_card: The July material does not represent a new project award or final licence decision. It refines the same Window 1 policy process with revised minded-to licence conditions and guidance.

source_to_add.claim: Ofgem published revised minded-to special licence conditions on 21 July, added licence-condition guidance on 28 July, and says final decisions remain after the autumn 2026 cap-and-floor awards.
source_to_add.source_contribution: Clarifies the post-mind-to licensing framework, the 28 July guidance update, and that the process remains pre-final-decision.
